prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE complete EXISTING DooKnow OWNER DOCUMENT FORMATTING TOOLBAR local strip only, no owner rail/header/note body, no invented window/close/footer/dialog. Image1 actual rich-editor baseline determines real toolbar appearance/state; Image2 PILOT flat palette/density only. Render a wide natural-size toolbar on neutral background around1536×512, every existing control visible/readable, source groups separated by fine vertical dividers. Flat white/#f7f8fa, #272b3a/#657084 text, #e6e9f1 lines, #4566c6/#edf1ff selected UI, restrained corners. No developer label/legend, no copied note content.
Source state heading1 selected, left alignment selected, code=false, normal marks false, disabled=false, uploading=false; indent/outdent context-disabled as actual baseline. All dropdowns/popovers CLOSED, no nested menu/table/color chooser simultaneously.
Preserve exactly the complete source control order with recognizable thin icons and real groups:
(1) HeadingPicker displaying 标题 1 with downward chevron.
(2) B bold, I italic, S strikethrough, inline-code angle/bracket icon, T× clear formatting.
(3) TextColorPicker A with black underline and small dropdown chevron.
(4) left/center/right alignment icons, ONLY left has selected pale-blue fill.
(5) quote, unordered list, ordered list, task-list checkbox icon, indent and outdent (last2 disabled).
(6) insert link chain, code-block icon, table-grid picker withchevron, horizontal rule, image/attachment upload icon (not uploading).
(7) insert whiteboard icon.
(8) search magnifier (查找替换), plus (快捷插入), settings (笔记属性), clipboard/paste (按 Markdown 粘贴), backward-reference arrow (反向引用), download/export icon (导出 HTML), printer (打印笔记).
ALL29 control functions including heading/color/tables must be retained; do not replace missing controls with decorative dots or new features. Source tooltip/aria meanings are described here, not permanently added as product text labels unless already visible. It is one toolbar, not a menu inventory chart. No undo/redo/save/share/mode tabs/chapter sidebar because these belong to separate host chrome, no font-family/size selector/AI. Preserve exact source flags and keyboard/select-preservation semantics as metadata, not protocol fields. No caption beyond actual visible toolbar labels.
